notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update is focused on fixing all the problems with inventories and storage containers such as car trunks or storage chests. 

Sadly, after this update you will need to start a new game, because the way save now works is different.

- Fixed items duplication
- Fixed chest disappearing on load
- Fixed inventory items alignment
- Fixed Furnace items not saving on exiting
- Fixed furnace light
- Fixed campfire light
- Added salt to drops
- Added vegetables to drops

Next update will be focused on FPS optimization.

- Fixed chest disappearing on load
- Fixed inventory items alignment
- Fixed Furnace items not saving on exiting
- Fixed furnace light
- Fixed campfire light

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
This is the list of features that will be focused during the next three months (the order they will get developed might be different):

New features:

- Full Controller support

- Interiors to every building and containers to loot

- Buildable base defenses

- Dynamic spawnable enemy bases or random event such as airdrop, crashed plane or AI rescuing with containing special loot

- Hordes attacking your base based on a random factor

- Companion AI's to help defend the base

- More vehicles such as cars, motorbikes, mini helicopter, military grade vehicles, also thinking about horses and bicycle

- Gun customization (Silencer, scopes, mag sizes, recoil stabilizer)

- Map expansion

Also, there will be a focus on FPS optimization and bug fixing
